description.value: Author, Humorist, Entrepreneur, Publisher, and Lecturer. Samuel Langhorne Clemens was born on November 30, 1835, in Florida, Missouri. When he was 4 years old, his family moved from Florida to nearby Hannibal on the Mississippi River where he grew up on the waterfront. His father, John Marshall Clemens, was an attorney and judge who died of pneumonia in 1847 when Clemens was 11. The following year, Samuel left school after the fifth grade to become a printer's apprentice...
